sources.label: Patch for Android application and implementation of new features.
sources.author: Wagg13Patch_Morphe
patch_list: Stops the app from telling BuzzCast every time you open it.
Stops the app from collecting your usage and advertising data.
Hides the promotional banner in the middle of the home list.
Hides the "joined" and "followed" messages in live chats and the join banner at the top.
Hides the rotating event and gift cards in the corner of live rooms.
Removes the "healthy live streaming" message shown in every live chat.
Stops the pop-ups that ask you to rate the app.
Skips the full-screen promotion shown when the app opens.
Stops the pop-up that asks you to update the app.
Unlocks SVIP features and removes ads and purchase pop-ups.
